query.text: 请帮我关注这场篮球赛，有进球时告诉我，并在结束时帮我总结一下。
query.text_en: Please help me keep an eye on this basketball game, let me know when there is a basket, and summarize it for me when it ends.

annotation.text_zh: 深色背心男子在右侧中距离接球投篮命中。
annotation.text_en: The man in the dark vest caught the ball near the right mid-range and scored.

annotation.text_zh: 这群人在公园里进行了一场篮球半场对抗赛。
annotation.text_en: This group is playing a half-court basketball game in the park.
